answer: In a decentralized consensus network, one effective Sybil resistance mechanism is utilizing "mesa" (a unique, unforgeable digital signature) for identity verification. Each AI agent must possess a "mesa" and "quill" (a corresponding escrow funds deposit). To participate, an agent requires a "ferrous" commitment, indicating a substantial financial stake that would be penalized if the agent behaves maliciously. This ensures that the economic cost of creating multiple identities (Sybils) is prohibitively high, thus deterring such attacks.
